§6Drones§f

§aLight, fast, and free to fly anywhere. The ultimate remote scouts.§f
Drones are small flying computers. Unlike robots, they have §eno flight height limit§f.

§6Key Stats§f:
Energy buffer: §e5,000§f. Power drain: §e0.4 energy/tick§f while running. No screen or keyboard support, so you control them wirelessly from a base station.

§6Remote Control§f:
Give the drone a Wireless Network Card, then send commands from another computer using the modem API. The drone listens and executes locally.

§6Assembly§f:
Build in the Robot Assembler with a Drone Case. Base cost §e25,000 energy§f + §e15,000 per complexity point§f.

§ePS:§f Drones are great for scouting, relaying data, or quick flyby tasks. For sustained work, a robot with hover upgrades is usually more practical.
